test_title: PYST 33: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

Nigeria ______restrictions in place since 2015 in a bid to boost local production.
solution:
The correct answer is **"has had."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the present perfect tense, which uses the auxiliary verb **"has/have"** and the past participle (V3) form of the main verb.
 
• **Structure: Subject + has/have + V3 + Object**
 
 
• **Example: ***She **has done**__ her work.*
 
 
 
• **"Nigeria"** is a singular subject, so it needs the singular form of the verb **"has".**
 
• The phrase **"in place since 2015"** indicates a duration of time that started in the past and continues to the present.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**:* **Nigeria __**has had**__ restrictions in place since 2015 in a bid to boost local production. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, **"have had",** is grammatically incorrect because it uses a plural verb form with a singular subject.
 
• Option 3,** "have has",** is also incorrect because it uses two auxiliary verbs together.
 
• Option 4,** "had has"**, is incorrect because it uses the past simple form of "have" instead of the present perfect form.
